name: Dankayo
description: Dankayo was a world in the Colonies on the Shwuy Exchange with a Alliance to Restore the Republic administrative base, known as Dankayo Base, that served three sectors for purposes of coordination and records. Part of the area within its purview was Ralltiir sector.
